major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it only once Eye Beam is on cooldown, both Immolation Aura charges are spent and your Demonsurge empowerments are used, and never macro trinkets or your potion into it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 200166 is the id seen in casts in all five sampled parses; the guide cites 191427 and 162264 is the demon form aura used by the rules.

major_cooldowns.name: Eye Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown a global after Vengeful Retreat so Initiative and Inertia amplify the beam and the Demonsurge explosions behind it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown is 30s and the sampled parses average about eight casts each, which matches it; the guide's Inertia build drives the effective cooldown toward 20s once Cycle of Hatred is stacked.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown with Eye Beam nearly ready, and as Aldrachi Reaver throw any Reaver's Glaive you are holding first or the new one is wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Essence Break
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown in demon form, hold it when Eye Beam is about to return, and use only Death Sweep and Annihilation until the debuff falls.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Never sit on two charges, and spend them all before Metamorphosis because Violent Transformation resets both.

major_cooldowns.name: Abyssal Gaze
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press this empowered Eye Beam inside Metamorphosis once your Death Sweep and Annihilation empowerments are spent.

major_cooldowns.name: Consuming Fire
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Always press this empowered Immolation Aura while Metamorphosis is up, and stay close to the pack as it ends so Ragefire lands.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Fel-Scarred Demonic Intensity ability; the guide cites 452487 and 456640 shares the name, and neither was pressed in the sampled parses, where the casts may be recorded under Immolation Aura 258920.

defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Press it ahead of predictable physical damage for the dodge and damage reduction.
defensives.id_note: 198589 is the cast id; 212800 is the matching self aura.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group before a raid-wide hit so everyone gets a chance to avoid it.

rules.description: Open with Eye Beam and Death Sweep before Meta
rules.action: Send Eye Beam and spend its Death Sweep burst before you press Metamorphosis.

rules.description: Vengeful Retreat one global before Eye Beam
rules.action: Press Vengeful Retreat one global before Eye Beam so Initiative and Inertia amp the beam.

rules.description: Eye Beam on cooldown before Metamorphosis
rules.action: Send Eye Beam first so Chaotic Transformation resets it instead of wasting the reset.

rules.description: Essence Break after Eye Beam, not before it
rules.action: Hold Essence Break when Eye Beam is about to return and press it right after the beam.

rules.description: Essence Break only in demon form
rules.action: Save Essence Break for demon form so you can spend the window on Death Sweep and Annihilation.

rules.description: The Hunt just before Eye Beam
rules.action: Save The Hunt until Eye Beam is nearly ready so Eternal Hunt doubles the beam.

rules.description: Felblade only with room for its Fury
rules.action: Dump Fury into Chaos Strike before you press Felblade.

source_summary: Havoc funnels everything into one burst chain: Immolation Aura charges and Eye Beam go out first, The Hunt lands with the beam nearly ready, and Metamorphosis comes last so Chaotic Transformation resets Eye Beam and Death Sweep. Vengeful Retreat is pressed a global before every Eye Beam for the Initiative and Inertia amps, Essence Break is cast on cooldown in demon form unless the beam is about to return, and the window after it is spent only on Death Sweep and Annihilation. Fel-Scarred adds Abyssal Gaze and Consuming Fire inside Metamorphosis, while Aldrachi Reaver spends each Reaver's Glaive before The Hunt regenerates one.
